sections.md: **Substantive scope.** [jurisdictional_scope] Closing clause: "This Regulation shall be binding in its entirety and directly applicable in all Member States." Recital 5: the accession of Croatia to the European Union on 1 July 2013 and the Article 18a(1) Directive 2003/87/EC criteria for determining an aircraft operator's administering Member State imply that certain aircraft operators should now be administered by Croatia. Article 1: the Annex to Regulation (EC) No 748/2009 is replaced by the Annex to this Regulation. Recital 4: an aircraft operator's inclusion in the EU ETS depends on performing an Annex I Directive 2003/87/EC aviation activity, not on inclusion in this Article 18a(3) list.

**Operational implication, legal confirmation required.** *Operational implication:* this Regulation itself creates no new compliance obligation, fee, or deadline for aircraft operators; it re-attributes which Member State administers certain aircraft operators' EU ETS compliance following Croatia's accession, effective 07/09/2013 (derived). Aircraft operators should confirm their current administering Member State against the replacement Annex (not individually captured here) rather than the superseded Regulation (EC) No 748/2009 list. *Legal Confirmation Required:* an aircraft operator's specific administering-Member-State attribution under the replacement Annex, and any resulting compliance-authority change, should be confirmed with counsel or the relevant national competent authority before relying on this brief operationally.

[effective_date] Derived: Article 2 provides this Regulation "shall enter into force on the third day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union"; OJ publication is dated 4.9.2013 (OJ L 236, 4.9.2013, p. 1), giving a derived entry-into-force date of 07/09/2013.

[primary_deadline] Gap: no compliance deadline distinct from the Article 2 entry-into-force date was found in the captured text; the Regulation's sole substantive effect (Article 1) is an immediate, one-time Annex replacement.

**Coverage note.** Commission Regulation (EU) No 815/2013 of 27 August 2013, published OJ L 236, 4.9.2013, p. 1, amending Regulation (EC) No 748/2009 (the EU aviation-ETS list of aircraft operators and administering Member States, established under Article 18a(3) of Directive 2003/87/EC) to take into consideration Croatia's 1 July 2013 accession to the European Union. Adopted by the European Commission under the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union and Directive 2003/87/EC, Article 18a(3)(b). This brief addresses the Regulation's own recitals and two operative Articles as captured from the EUR-Lex CELEX:32013R0815 legal-content page; the replacement Annex itself (the operator-by-operator administering-state list) was captured but not individually itemised.

**Penalty.** [penalty_summary] Gap: no penalty, fine, or sanctions provision was identified anywhere in this Regulation's captured recitals, operative Articles, or replacement Annex (full-text position() search for "enalt" and "sanction"/"Sanction" across the entire 3.1M-character captured document returned zero matches). This Regulation carries no enforcement mechanism of its own; ETS compliance penalties (where applicable) derive from Directive 2003/87/EC and national implementing legislation, not from this Regulation's own text.

         <p class="oj-doc-ti">of 27 August 2013
         </p>
         <p class="oj-doc-ti">amending Regulation (EC) No 748/2009 on the list of aircraft operators that performed an aviation activity listed in Annex I to Directive 2003/87/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council on or after 1 January 2006 specifying the administering Member State for each aircraft operator to take into consideration the accession of Croatia to the European Union</p>
         <p class="oj-doc-ti">(Text with EEA relevance)</p>
      </div>
      <div class="eli-subdivision" id="pbl_1">
         <p class="oj-normal">THE EUROPEAN COMMISSION,</p>
         <div class="eli-subdivision" id="cit_1">
            <p class="oj-normal">Having regard to the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union,</p>
         </div>
         <div class="eli-subdivision" id="cit_2">
            <p class="oj-normal">Having regard to Directive 2003/87/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 October 2003 establishing a scheme for greenhouse gas emission allowance trading within the Community and amending Council Directive 96/61/EC <a id="ntc1-L_2013236EN.01000101-E0001" href="#ntr1-L_2013236EN.01000101-E0001">(<span class="oj-super oj-note-tag">1</span>)</a>, and in particular Article 18a(3)(b) thereof,</p>
         </div>
         <p class="oj-normal">Whereas:</p>
         <div class="eli-subdivision" id="rct_1">
            <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
               <col width="4%"/>
               <col width="96%"/>
               <tbody>
                  <tr>
                     <td valign="top">
                        <p class="oj-normal">(1)</p>
                     </td>
                     <td valign="top">
                        <p class="oj-normal">Directive 2008/101/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council <a id="ntc2-L_2013236EN.01000101-E0002" href="#ntr2-L_2013236EN.01000101-E0002">(<span class="oj-super oj-note-tag">2</span>)</a> amended Directive 2003/87/EC to include aviation activities in the scheme for greenhouse gas emission allowance trading within the European Union.</p>
                     </td>
                  </tr>
               </tbody>
            </table>
         </div>
         <div class="eli-subdivision" id="rct_2">
            <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
               <col width="4%"/>
               <col width="96%"/>
               <tbody>
                  <tr>
                     <td valign="top">
                        <p class="oj-normal">(2)</p>
                     </td>
                     <td valign="top">
                        <p class="oj-normal">Commission Regulation (EC) No 748/2009 <a id="ntc3-L_2013236EN.01000101-E0003" href="#ntr3-L_2013236EN.01000101-E0003">(<span class="oj-super oj-note-tag">3</span>)</a> establishes a list of aircraft operators which had performed an aviation activity as defined in Annex I to Directive 2003/87/EC on or after 1 January 2006.</p>
                     </td>
                  </tr>
               </tbody>
            </table>
         </div>
         <div class="eli-subdivision" id="rct_3">
            <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
               <col width="4%"/>
               <col width="96%"/>
               <tbody>
                  <tr>
                     <td valign="top">
                        <p class="oj-normal">(3)</p>
                     </td>
                     <td valign="top">
                        <p class="oj-normal">That list aims to reduce the administrative burden on aircraft operators by providing information on which Member State will be regulating a particular aircraft operator.</p>
                     </td>
                  </tr>
               </tbody>
            </table>
         </div>
         <div class="eli-subdivision" id="rct_4">
            <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
               <col width="4%"/>
               <col width="96%"/>
               <tbody>
                  <tr>
                     <td valign="top">
                        <p class="oj-normal">(4)</p>
                     </td>
                     <td valign="top">
                        <p class="oj-normal">The inclusion of an aircraft operator in the Union's emissions trading scheme is dependent upon the performance of an aviation activity as set out in Annex I to Directive 2003/87/EC and is not dependent on the inclusion in the list of aircraft operators established by the Commission on the basis of Article 18a(3) of that Directive.</p>
                     </td>
                  </tr>
               </tbody>
            </table>
         </div>
         <div class="eli-subdivision" id="rct_5">
            <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
               <col width="4%"/>
               <col width="96%"/>
               <tbody>
                  <tr>
                     <td valign="top">
                        <p class="oj-normal">(5)</p>
                     </td>
                     <td valign="top">
                        <p class="oj-normal">The accession of Croatia to the European Union on 1 July 2013 and the criteria set under Article 18a(1) of Directive 2003/87/EC to determine an aircraft operator's administering Member State imply that certain aircraft operators should be administered by Croatia.</p>
                     </td>
                  </tr>
               </tbody>
            </table>
         </div>
         <div class="eli-subdivision" id="rct_6">
            <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
               <col width="4%"/>
               <col width="96%"/>
               <tbody>
                  <tr>
                     <td valign="top">
                        <p class="oj-normal">(6)</p>
                     </td>
                     <td valign="top">
                        <p class="oj-normal">Regulation (EC) No 748/2009 should therefore be amended accordingly,</p>
                     </td>
                  </tr>
               </tbody>
            </table>
         </div>
         <p class="oj-normal">HAS ADOPTED THIS REGULATION:</p>
      </div>
      <div class="eli-subdivision" id="enc_1">
         <div class="eli-subdivision" id="art_1">
            <p id="d1e134-1-1" class="oj-ti-art">Article 1</p>
            <p class="oj-normal">The Annex to Regulation (EC) No 748/2009 is replaced by the Annex to this Regulation.</p>
         </div>
         <div class="eli-subdivision" id="art_2">
            <p id="d1e139-1-1" class="oj-ti-art">Article 2</p>
            <p class="oj-normal">This Regulation shall enter into force on the third day following that of its publication in the <span class="oj-italic">Official Journal of the European Union</span>.</p>
         </div>
      </div>
      <div class="eli-subdivision" id="fnp_1">
         <div class="oj-final">
            <p class="oj-normal">This Regulation shall be binding in its entirety and directly applicable in all Member States.</p>
            <p class="oj-normal">Done at Brussels, 27 August 2013.</p>
            <div class="oj-signatory">
               <p class="oj-signatory">
                  <span class="oj-italic">For the Commission</span>
               </p>
               <p class="oj-signatory">
                  <span class="oj-italic">The President</span>
               </p>
               <p class="oj-signatory">José Manuel BARROSO
            </p>
            </div>
         </div>
      </div>
